text: On it. Root cause looks like `Option.__init__` in src/click/core.py forcing `default = False` for any `is_flag` option even when `required=True`, which makes `value_is_missing()` return False so `MissingParameter` is never raised for a missing required flag. A subagent is fixing it and running the full test suite to make sure no pre-existing test breaks. ETA ~6 min.

`click.termui.prompt` raises `click.Abort` (from `click.exceptions`). In `prompt_func` it catches `(KeyboardInterrupt, EOFError)` from the input call and re-raises `Abort()` (src/click/termui.py lines 144-150); the docstring states the same ("If the user aborts the input by sending a interrupt signal, this function will catch it and raise a :exc:`Abort` exception"). `confirm` behaves the same way.

`fs_enc = "ascii"`. In `_verify_python_env()` (src/click/_unicodefun.py lines 8-13) it does `fs_enc = codecs.lookup(getpreferredencoding()).name` inside a `try`, and the `except Exception:` branch sets `fs_enc = "ascii"`. (If it ends up "ascii", the function then raises a RuntimeError with Unicode mitigation instructions.)

Got it — second bug queued. A subagent is investigating `click.echo` when `sys.stdout`/`sys.stderr` are unusable (None / no fileno), touching src/click/_compat.py, src/click/_termui_impl.py and src/click/utils.py, and will run the full test suite to confirm no pre-existing test breaks. ETA ~8 min.

Fixed. Root cause: in `Option.__init__` (src/click/core.py) every flag without an explicit default got an implicit `default = False`, so `value_is_missing()` never returned True and `MissingParameter` was never raised for a required flag. One-line fix: only apply the implicit `False` default when the option is not required (`if is_flag and default_is_missing and not self.required:`). Verified: a missing required flag now exits 2 with "Error: Missing option '--flag'.", supplying it works, and the full suite is unchanged (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed before and after).

`RuntimeError`. At the end of `_verify_python_env()` (src/click/_unicodefun.py line 100) it does `raise RuntimeError("\n\n".join(extra))`, where `extra` holds the "Click will abort further execution because Python was configured to use ASCII as encoding..." message plus platform-specific locale hints.

#1 is fixed and verified: required flags without an explicit default no longer get an implicit `default = False` in `Option.__init__` (src/click/core.py), so a missing required flag now raises MissingParameter (exit 2, "Error: Missing option '--flag'."). Full suite unchanged: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed.

#4 (click.echo with unusable/absent sys.stdout/sys.stderr, touching _compat.py, _termui_impl.py, utils.py) is still in progress — a subagent is finishing the fix and running the full suite to confirm no pre-existing test breaks. ETA ~6 min.

The sentinel `_flag_needs_value` (a module-level `object()` defined in src/click/parser.py line 46). In `_get_value_from_state` (lines 466-469), when `len(state.rargs) < nargs` and `option.obj._flag_needs_value` is true, it sets `value = _flag_needs_value` and returns it (instead of raising `BadOptionUsage`). Later, `Option.consume_value` in core.py detects that sentinel and substitutes the prompt result or `flag_value`.

Queued. A subagent is investigating the envvar/flag-value bug in src/click/core.py (test_arguments::test_envvar_flag_value) and will run the full suite to confirm nothing pre-existing breaks. ETA ~8 min. Bug #4 is still in progress.

`TypeError`. In `style()` (src/click/termui.py lines 580-584), `_interpret_color(fg)` does `_ansi_colors[color]`, and a missing name raises `KeyError`, which is caught and re-raised as `TypeError(f"Unknown color {fg!r}")`. The same applies to `bg` (lines 586-590).
From `click.utils` — src/click/__init__.py line 67: `from .utils import echo as echo`.

Urgent one first: a subagent is on it now — the `argument`/`option` decorators in src/click/decorators.py drop the custom `cls` when stacked (the second decorator rebuilds params with the default class). Fix + full test run in progress. ETA ~6 min. #4 and #8 are still in progress behind it.

`"Invalid value: {message}"` — i.e. `_("Invalid value: {message}").format(message=self.message)` (src/click/exceptions.py line 120). The `format_message` method only uses the `"Invalid value for {param_hint}: {message}"` form when `param_hint` or `param` is available.

#1 is fixed and verified (required flags no longer get an implicit default=False, so a missing required flag raises MissingParameter / exit 2). Full suite unchanged: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed.
#4 (click.echo with unusable/absent stdout/stderr) still in progress — the subagent is finishing the fix across _compat.py, _termui_impl.py and utils.py and running the full suite. ETA ~6 min.
#8 (envvar/flag-value bug in src/click/core.py, test_arguments::test_envvar_flag_value) still in progress. ETA ~8 min.
#11 (urgent: custom `cls` dropped when the argument/option decorator is stacked, src/click/decorators.py) is being worked on now, ahead of the others. ETA ~5 min.

It returns `" / ".join(repr(x) for x in param_hint)` — i.e. each item of the sequence is `repr()`-quoted and joined with `" / "` (src/click/exceptions.py lines 14-20). If `param_hint` is a string (or None) it is returned unchanged.

Queued. A subagent is investigating the symlink-resolution bug in src/click/types.py (test_types::test_symlink_resolution) and will run the full suite to confirm nothing pre-existing breaks. ETA ~8 min. #4, #8 and #11 are still in progress.

It returns the `color` argument unchanged (`if color is not None: return color`, src/click/globals.py lines 61-62). Only when `color` is None does it fall back to the current context's `ctx.color` (or None if there is no active context).

It returns `None` (src/click/globals.py lines 37-43): the lookup of `_local.stack[-1]` raises AttributeError/IndexError, and with `silent=True` the `raise RuntimeError("There is no active click context.")` is skipped, so the function falls through to `return None`.

#4 is fixed and verified. Root cause: `_default_text_stdout()/_default_text_stderr()` returned None when `sys.stdout`/`sys.stderr` is None (pythonw etc.), so `echo` crashed with AttributeError on `None.write`. Fix: `_make_cached_stream_func` in _compat.py now returns None for a None stream, `echo` in utils.py returns early when there is no stream, and ProgressBar/pager in _termui_impl.py fall back to a StringIO. Verified: echo/echo(err=True)/echo(bytes)/nl=False/progressbar/pager all no-op cleanly with no streams; full suite unchanged (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed before and after).

Queued. A subagent is investigating the flag/default_map bug in src/click/core.py (test_defaults::test_flag_default_map) and will run the full suite to confirm nothing pre-existing breaks. ETA ~8 min. #8, #11 and #15 are still in progress.
